medium.title: Ibovespa: What to Expect from the Index in July and the Coming Quarters, According to BTG's Technical Analysis
medium.summary: According to BTG Pactual's technical analysis team, July historically ranks as one of the most favorable months for the Ibovespa, characterized by above-average positive returns, a high frequency of gains, and lower volatility relative to other calendar months. This seasonal analysis takes on added significance in 2026 after the index lost momentum during Q2. The Ibovespa has accumulated a gain of 6.76% year-to-date as of the report's publication. For equity investors with Brazil exposure, the seasonal tailwind combined with the post-Q2 consolidation may present a tactical re-entry opportunity. Investors should watch whether positive seasonality materializes against the backdrop of still-elevated Selic rates and any fiscal policy developments that could dampen risk appetite on B3.

medium.title: Itaú BBA Reshuffles 80% of Recommended Stock Portfolio for July
medium.summary: Itaú BBA made sweeping changes to its monthly recommended equity portfolio for July, rotating out Aura Minerals (AURA33), BTG Pactual (BPAC11), Equatorial (EQTL3), and Petrobras (PETR4), while adding Embraer (EMBJ3), Nubank (ROXO34), Sabesp (SBSP3), and Bradesco (BBDC4). The sole holdover from June is Axia Energia (AXIA3). Notably, the June portfolio underperformed significantly, falling 4.5% versus the Ibovespa's 1% decline — a 3.5 percentage point gap. The removal of Petrobras is particularly noteworthy for macro-focused investors, as it signals reduced conviction in the state-owned energy giant near-term. The addition of Bradesco may reflect a view that the banking sector offers better risk-adjusted upside at current interest rate levels.
